note: Should-trigger phrasings about a company's legal and compliance work, and near misses that a neighbouring skill, or the user's own lawyer, owns. Used by the description trigger check.
should_trigger: review this vendor contract before we sign it
redline the NDA a prospect sent our company
draft terms of service and a privacy policy for our app
do we need a DPA with our analytics provider
should my startup be an LLC or a Delaware C-corp
a competitor sent us a cease and desist letter, what do we do
make sure our cofounders and contractors assign their IP to the company
can we trademark our company's name
what does GDPR require of us now that we have EU customers
set up a compliance calendar for our company's filings
a customer is threatening to sue us over a missed delivery date
what should our position be on the liability cap in this MSA

near_miss.route: a lawyer of the user's own (a personal matter)
